title: ornithidium affine
intro: Ornithidium affine, commonly known as "Tetrameria affine," is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ornithidium affine include treating fever, respiratory issues, and skin conditions, as well as exerting a calming effect on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
